detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Beekeeper Simulator is a chill first-person simulation game where you get to experience what it is like to run your own bee farm. Care for your bees, harvest and sell your honey and expand your operation to create a successful beekeeping business.

Care for bees Learn to build beehives like a real beekeeper. Fill your hives with bees and watch them get to work. Use your profit to upgrade your hives with additional layers, deeper frames and more bees!

Produce honey! Use a centrifuge to extract the honey produced by your bees. Pour the honey into jars or sell it in bulk. Upgrade your workflow into an automated system to add efficiency or keep it manual for a more laid-back experience. 

Keep your bees happy! Bees need flowers in order to produce honey. Plant seeds near your hives and keep the flowers hydrated to keep the bees pollinating. Use your XP to unlock the Garden Hose for quicker watering.

Play together with friends Start your beekeeping business together with a partner. Divide your roles or work together for maximum productivity. How fast can you sell 1 000 000 jars of honey to unlock the Golden Garden Gnome?
